package.name: my_boat_description
package.description: URDF description of the custom boat hull for VRX / Gazebo Garden. Provides the pure rigid body only: CG-centred base_link, the imported DAE hull visual, a simplified collision box, and the real mass/inertia from the CAD mass-properties report. Mirrors the role of wamv_description; marine physics is layered on by my_boat_gazebo.
